summary: Reporter native label was NICE (pre-existing, unchanged context lines, not touched by this diff) but re-derivation against the severity rubric shows this is genuinely I3 (wrong result silently substituted and presented as correct) at E3 (any authenticated operator, default config) -> HIGH, which the ledger park-probe correctly refuses to let through as a deferred finding. classification_rationale: the code silently substitutes a default value on wrong-typed input, contradicting the caller intent a malformed filter value expresses
